title: One letter, different sounds: p, t, k
pedagogy: Identify syllable-initial versus syllable-final sounds in real words; practise unreleased stop endings and their spelling groups before tone rules.

exercises.title: Position means position in a syllable
body: A letter can sound different at the start and end of a syllable. Identify which syllable it belongs to; its place in the whole word is not enough.
For example, ด starts ดี with d, but ends แปด with t. บ starts บาท with b, but ends สิบ with p.
This lesson tests the consonant sound, not the tone. Tap a word to hear it. The feedback explains the letter’s role.

exercises.title: บ: b at the start, p at the end
body: บาท means baht. Its first consonant บ is pronounced b; its last consonant ท is pronounced t.
สิบ means ten. Here บ is the final consonant, so it sounds p, not b.
For a final p, close your lips and stop. Do not add a vowel or a released puff after it.

exercises.question: What sound does บ make at the start of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: บ starts บาท, so it has its starting sound b. It is not the final consonant.

exercises.question: What sound does บ make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: บ ends สิบ, so it sounds p. Close your lips to end the syllable without adding a vowel.

exercises.title: ด: d at the start, t at the end
body: ด starts ดี, meaning good, with d. In ลด, meaning reduce, ด is final and sounds t.
Other starting sounds also become t at the end: จ and ช (ch), ซ ศ ษ ส (s), and ถ ท ธ (th).
A final t ends with the tongue closing the airflow. Do not release it with another vowel.

exercises.question: What sound does ด make at the start of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ด starts ดี with d. Compare final ด in ลด, where it sounds t.

exercises.question: What sound does ด make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ด ends ลด with t, even though the same letter starts ดี with d.

exercises.question: What sound does จ make at the start of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: จ starts จาก with ch. It would sound t as a syllable-final consonant.

exercises.question: What sound does ส make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ส ends รส with t, not s. รส has an unwritten short o vowel; focus here on final ส.

exercises.question: What sound does ท make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ท ends บาท. Its starting sound th becomes t at the end of a syllable.

exercises.title: ข and ค lose the puff at the end
body: ข and ค begin syllables with kh. As final consonants, they sound k, like final ก and ฆ.
In เลข, meaning number, ข is final: the word ends with k, not kh.
A final k ends by closing the airflow at the back of the mouth. Do not add a puff or a vowel.

exercises.question: What sound does ข make at the start of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ข starts ขอ with kh. อ is part of the vowel here.

exercises.question: What sound does ข make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ข ends เลข with k. Compare starting ข in ขอ: kh at the start, k at the end.

exercises.question: What sound does ก make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ก ends มาก with k. Some letters, including ก, have the same basic sound at the start and end.

exercises.title: Three stop endings, many spellings
body: The usual k-ending spellings are ก ข ค ฆ. The usual p-ending spellings are บ ป พ ฟ ภ.
The t-ending group includes จ ช ซ ฎ ฏ ฐ ฑ ฒ ด ต ถ ท ธ ศ ษ ส. Learn the groups gradually through words rather than memorising the entire list now.
These are pronounced syllable endings. Silent letters and special spelling patterns need separate rules; not every last written letter is a pronounced ending.
